definitions.short: Beth-ha-Jeshimoth , a town East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1020. Beth Hayshimoth הַיְשִׁימוֺת בֵּית proper name, of a location east of Jordan ( place of the desert , ישׁם ) in Moab Ezek 25:9 ; ׳בּ הַיְשִׁמֹת Num 33:49 ; Josh 12:3 ; given to Reuben ׳בּ הַיְשִׁמוֺת 13:20 ; — perhaps modern es-Suweime , De Saulcy Voyage i. 315 f. , compare Merrill PE Soc. iv. 1877 Bd Pal 172 Survey EP i. 156 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and the plural of 3451 with the article interposed; house of the deserts;
